scope: Individual review of all 25 current soundtrack covers for obvious physical-object SORA emblem centering or perspective faults, with special attention to vehicle hoods and jacket backs. Editorial corner badges are not required to be centered in the illustration.
result: No applicable physical-object centering faults found. All observed SORA emblems are editorial upper-left branding badges; this is not a claim that 25 physical surface placements passed.
limitations: Visual assessment at native resolution. Very small background objects cannot establish exact absence of microscopic detail. No pixel-identical logo-fidelity claim or full artwork-quality review is made.
